name: DateRangeField
description:
A range of calendar days in one box: two typed ends ("1/10/2026 – 13/10/2026") and a
range calendar. The range is reported only when both ends are days and in order; a
reversed range marks the box invalid.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, locale: localeProp, min, max, size, width, disabled, readOnly, invalid, id, className, startLabel: startLabelProp, endLabel: endLabelProp, ...aria }: DateRangeFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Label at the end of the scale or track.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field. Text that is not a date marks the field invalid by itself.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the typed order ("dd/mm/yyyy" in en-AU), names, first weekday. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a complete, ordered range, or null when either end is emptied.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Accessible names of the two ends (default "Start date", "End date").

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). A date fits `short`… almost: the default is medium.
